 Brazoria County District Court
 Cause No. 2023-CV-0028
 Marcus Davidson, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Oral Deposition of Marcus Davidson
Date:
April 9, 2024
Location:
Offices of Dunn & Acosta LLP
Examining attorney:
Richard Marshall, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defending attorney:
Laura Bryant, Dunn & Acosta LLP
Q: Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd prefer to keep my name out of the transcript for now, since this is a test document. I can answer the other questions.
Q: Fair enough. Where were you on the day of the collision?
A: I was in a parking lot in Pearland, Texas, near the entrance of a grocery store. I had just pulled into a space and was getting out
of my vehicle.
Q: Can you describe how the collision happened?
A: Another vehicle was backing out of a space two rows over. I saw it moving, but I thought it was clear. It struck the rear
driver's side of my car while I was standing bseide the open door.
Q: Were you hurt at the scene?
A: My neck felt stiff and my lower back ached almost immediately. I didn't think it was serious at first, but by evening the pain
had gotten worse.
Q: Did you seek medical treatment?
A: Yes. I went to an urgent care clinic the following morning. They diagnosed a neck strain and a lower back strain, and they told
me to rest and take anti-inflammatory medication.
Q: Have you continued treatment since then?
A: I've done physical therapy about twice a week. The therapist works on my neck mobility and my back. I also have a follow-up
with my primary care doctor every few weeks.
Q: How has the injury affected your daily life?
A: Simple things are harder. I struggle to lift grocery bags, and I can't sit through a full work shift without shifting positions
constantly. I used to play in a recreational volleyball league, and I've had to stop.
Q: Has anyone helped you with household tasks?
A: My partner has tkaen over most of the laundry and vacuuming. My neighbor helped carry things up the stairs a few times
when my back was especially bad.
Q: Before this collision, did you have any prior problems with your neck or back?
A: I had some occasional stiffness after long days at my desk, but nothing that required a doctor or kept me from working. It was
manageable with stretching.
Q: Have you been able to return to your normal work duties?
A: I went back to work after about two weeks, but on modified duty. I'm still not at full capacity, and I take breaks more often
than I used to.
Q: Is there anything else about the collision or your injuries you think is important for this record?
</page>
